notes: Modified cash basis village. Governmental lines from Total Governmental Funds 2024 column (p6; labels on p5). Taxes 285,527 split using the Schedule 2 totals column (p11: property 136,517, motor vehicle 13,480, sales 135,530; nonmajor funds have no taxes). Intergovernmental revenues 114,151 split using p11 sub-lines. Principal/interest paid on liabilities are printed under other financing sources (uses), recorded as debt service disbursements outside the printed total. Business-type from proprietary statement (p8, Totals 2024); disbursement total 329,608 = operating 309,723 + interest 19,885, printed on Statement of Activities p2. Balance sheet from government-wide Statement of Net Position (includes capital assets and debt, so the governmental funds statement was not used). Detail: Schedule 2 (major funds, per fund), Schedule 4 (nonmajor, per fund; Keno fund all zero), Schedule 6 (proprietary, Actual column). Schedule 5 budget comparison (fund groups only, p14) not recorded to avoid double counting. Zero-amount lines skipped. Read pages 1-15 of 15
